business_summary: Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited provides highway operations and maintenance services in India. The company offers highway maintenance services, including bituminous, rigid pavement, and preventative maintenance services; specialized maintenance services comprising microsurfacing and cold-in-place recycling services; and specialized construction services, such as tunneling, soil stabilization, full depth reclamation, and other infra development services. It also provides consultancy services. The company was formerly known as Markolines Traffic Controls Limited and changed its name to Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited in October 2021. Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited was incorporated in 2002 and is based in Navi Mumbai, India.
